newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Saturday in dull trade as buyers kept to the sidelines before Monday's general elections, dealers said.
"There are not many trucks available to transport cotton because they have either been hired by contesting candidates or taken by police for election duties," dealer Kishan Chand said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded between 2,050 ($50.96) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
